notes: Note: Use fairy ring AJR, or a slayer ring to quickly get to Troll Stronghold through the Secret Door just north-east of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon in the Fremennik Province. (Climbing boots are needed for a shortcut if you are taking this path to the Secret Door!)

steps.text: Talk to Ug in the south-west corner of the Troll Stronghold's middle level. Offer him your help.
chat: 1. Aww, you poor troll. What seems to be the problem?
3. Don't worry now, I'll see what I can do.

steps.text: Talk to Aga in the room to the north.
chat: 2. So... how's your... um... love life?

sections.title: Survival Techniques
notes: Items Required: rope, maple or yew logs, iron bar, swamp tar, bucket of wax, cake tin.

steps.text: Talk to Tenzing in the hut west of the Warriors' Guild in Burthorpe.
chat: 4. Do you know where I can find Trollweiss?
2. What would I need to make such a sled?

steps.text: Talk to Dunstan at the anvil in north-eastern Burthorpe.
Talk to him again to get the sled.
Use the swamp tar on the bucket of wax to get Wax.
Use the Wax on your Sled.

sections.title: Sledding
notes: Items Required: sled, climbing Boots(If not teleporting), Recommended: armour, stamina potions, energy potions.

steps.text: Run north-west from the Trollheim teleport to reach a cave just north-west of the Troll family (Troll child if you haven't done Desert Treasure.)
Enter the cave to the north-west (Not through the icy gate) then run north-west past the ice trolls.
Run to the end and exit through the crevasse.
Equip your sled, go south, and click to slide down the slope.
After the first Sled ride cutscene, walk west and pick some of the rare flowers. (Warning: don't start the next cutscene before collecting the flowers)

sections.title: The Things We Do For Love
notes: Items Required: Trollweiss, Food, Armour, and a Weapon.
: Arrg will attack immediately after the next step, using a combination of melee AND ranged attacks that can hit in the 30s, so be prepared!
::Arrg can de-spawn if not killed fast enough using the safe-spot, so killing him could be difficult on a low level account.

steps.text: Talk to Arrg. He will teleport you into the arena.
chat: 1. I am here to kill you!
